text:
Maria: Heads-up — I'm finalizing the routing behavior for service-account keys for the canary tomorrow. We hit a nasty case where an org-level key exceeded quota and the auth path silently fell back to a project token, which unexpectedly bumped billing for the customer.

Alex: yikes. link to the incident? want to see if it's a quota enforcement bug or routing policy.

Maria: https://incident.internal/INC-2026-78 — short summary: auth allowed fallback when the org quota was soft-limited. No explicit consent/notification in billing path.

Sam: Current routing policy summary as-is: prefer any key in same org > fallback to any project key > impersonation. There's no differentiation between org-owned SA and project SA. We should prefer same-project keys, and require explicit opt-in for cross-project fallbacks.

Jordan: Proposal for priority: 1) project-scoped key, 2) org-scoped key, 3) SA-impersonation token. That matches least-surprise billing attribution.

Alex: That will make some customers unhappy — some rely on org-keys for cross-project flows. We should make the priority operator-configurable and exposed in the console per-org.

Maria: Agreed. Default safe behavior = project_preferred. Add org-admin setting: org_policy.route_priority=org_first to flip. Console toggle required.

Ryan: Infra concerns: (1) need telemetry to detect silent fallbacks; (2) rollout must be non-disruptive. We can't change behavior for all customers overnight.

Maria: Telemetry plan: emit an auth.route_decision event for every decision with fields: route_source, attempted_keys (hashed), fallback_reason, cost_delta_estimate. Dashboard alert when fallback_rate > 0.5% over 1h for any org.

Sam: Example event payload (we'll store as a single string in events — ensure key ids are hashed):

```\n{ "auth.route_decision": {\n  "org_id": "o-123",\n  "route_source": "org_key",\n  "attempted_keys": ["hk_a1b2****","hk_c3d4****"],\n  "fallback_reason": "quota_exceeded",\n  "cost_delta_tokens": 242\n}}\n```

Jordan: Console UX: per-org opt-in with tooltip: "Fallback may route to other billing entities" and an override checkbox "Allow cross-project fallback". Default = OFF. Also show an info banner during rollout.

Alex: Rollout plan suggestion:
- feature-flag disabled by default
- telemetry-only mode (no behavior change) for 2 weeks
- enable project-preferred routing for 10% of orgs
- expand to 50% once metrics stable and console opt-in visible
- GA with org-admin override and docs

Maria: +1. Canary guard: when org opted-out, reject fallback with 409 + clear error explaining billing reason. Better than silent fallback.

Ryan: Implementation notes: cache org_policy with TTL=60s in auth-service to avoid DB hits. Add circuit-breaker metric for route decision latency and a histogram for route decision times.

devops-bot: deploy:auth-service v3.12.0 canary scheduled at 2026-03-21T15:00Z to env=canary

Alex: For backwards compatibility, add an API header override `x-rdwd-route-preference: org|project|strict` for internal partners. Must be logged in the route_decision event and restricted by policy.

Sam: Also add a console telemetry card: "Fallbacks by org" and "Estimated extra token cost" for billing team. Include top offending keys and sparkline.

Maria: Action items:
- @Alex: UI mock for org toggle + tooltip (EOD)
- @Ryan: telemetry event + cache implementation (due +3d)
- @Sam: auth proto update + tests (due +3d)
- @Jordan: rollout doc + 409 error codes (due +5d)

Alex: Question: should key detail pages show fallback history? That could help debugging.

Maria: Yes — key page should show fallback_history (last 30d) and small sparkline. Keep data aggregated and mask key ids.

Ryan: Storing attempted_keys in events may be sensitive. Use hashed_key_id and mask trailing characters, do not store raw keys or full ids.

Sam: Tests I'll add:
- unit tests: quota hit + disabled fallback + header override behavior
- integration test: simulate org_policy TTL expiry and ensure correct cache refresh

Jordan: I'll draft rollout playbook with rollback steps and monitoring. Add a short note for Billing that explains cost attribution when fallback occurs and where to look in console.

Maria: I'll open the RFC and link mocks + snippets here once created. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Alex: saw the deploy, will sync with @Maria after mocks done. :wave:

Maria: Closing thread for now — will update RFC link here once created.
